note: Access basis, licence posture and time semantics for every source ATLAS touches. A source is only usable when its access_basis says so; licence_status drives whether raw content may be committed.

sources.name: openFDA - Device UDI
sources.attribution: openFDA, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (CC0 1.0)
sources.time_semantics: publish_date is the per-record first-publication date; public_version_date is a version stamp and is never used as a clock

sources.name: AccessGUDID (NLM) device lookup
sources.authority: U.S. National Library of Medicine / FDA GUDID
sources.attribution: GUDID data, U.S. Food and Drug Administration / NLM AccessGUDID
sources.time_semantics: devicePublishDate is the per-record first-publication date (day quality); publicVersionDate is a version stamp
sources.rate_limit: not published; ATLAS uses a 1 request/second minimum interval

sources.name: openFDA - Device 510(k)
sources.attribution: openFDA, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (CC0 1.0)
sources.time_semantics: decision_date is an event clock; FDA publishes no per-record first-publication date for 510(k), so source_public_at is derived and flagged

sources.name: openFDA - Device PMA
sources.attribution: openFDA, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (CC0 1.0)
sources.time_semantics: decision_date is an event clock; source_public_at is derived and flagged

sources.name: Health Canada - Medical Devices Active Licence Listing (MDALL)
sources.access_basis: public JSON API and open-data release, no key required
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada
sources.time_semantics: first_licence_dt / first_licence_status_dt are event clocks; last_refresh_dt is a database refresh stamp and end_date is a cancellation date - neither is a publication date
sources.rate_limit: not published; some listing endpoints return the whole table (21-220 MB), so ATLAS uses id-keyed lookups and one bounded stream
sources.known_limitation: device_identifier is usually a manufacturer model/catalogue number, not a UDI-DI: 5,477 of 1,673,926 active rows are bare GTIN-14 (5,512 after separator normalisation; 0.33%). Cross-market UDI linkage is therefore available only for the UDI-adopting subset.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.redistribution: allowed with attribution; abstracts may carry publisher restrictions
sources.time_semantics: publication_date is the public clock; created/updated are index clocks
sources.note: Planned Phase 4 source; the connector contract is defined but no ATLAS-001 collection was run.

sources.name: Europe PMC
sources.redistribution: metadata allowed; full text varies by article licence
sources.rate_limit: not published; ATLAS would use >=1s interval

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
sources.attribution: ClinicalTrials.gov, U.S. National Library of Medicine
sources.time_semantics: first_posted is the public clock; submitted dates are earlier private clocks
sources.rate_limit: not published; ATLAS would use >=1s interval

sources.name: EPO Open Patent Services
sources.access_basis: requires free OAuth registration and consumer key; no credentials are committed
sources.redistribution: raw bibliographic data may be redistributed under OPS terms; not attempted here
sources.attribution: European Patent Office, Open Patent Services
sources.time_semantics: publication_date is the public clock; filing_date is an event clock
sources.rate_limit: weekly quota depends on registered plan
sources.note: Project owner must register; ATLAS does not create accounts or use third-party credentials.

sources.name: USPTO Open Data Portal
sources.authority: United States Patent and Trademark Office
sources.access_basis: public bulk files and API; some endpoints need a free API key
sources.attribution: United States Patent and Trademark Office

sources.name: EU Tenders Electronic Daily (TED)
sources.access_basis: public search API; some bulk endpoints need registration
sources.attribution: TED, Publications Office of the European Union
